title: Black Bean and Mushroom Dal
description: A dry-style dal-inspired curry of mushrooms and black-eyed beans in a spiced tomato sauce, finished with coriander and lemon.
ingredients: 400g (14oz) can of black-eyed beans, drained and rinsed
1 green chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
TO SERVE: coriander leaves, lemon wedges
steps: Spray a sauté pan or deep frying pan with oil and fry the onion for 5 minutes, then add the cumin seeds, pepper, garam masala and mushrooms and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, black-eyed beans and chilli and simmer for 15 minutes. The curry should have quite a dry consistency.
Season to taste with salt and serve scattered with coriander leaves and with lemon wedges on the side.
notes: Can be eaten as a stand-alone meal or served alongside curries for an Indian spread.
